art.title: The Healing of the Paralytic
art.why: Exactly Mark 2:1-12: the healed man carrying his bedding away. Existing art id, used only by the story bank, not by another journey.

art.title: Saint Peter
art.why: Peter holding two large red keys: the confession at Caesarea Philippi and Matthew's 'keys of the kingdom' (Matthew 16:19). No 'Christ giving the keys' is free.

No stilling of the storm or feeding of the five thousand. magnasco-sea-galilee (used by the story bank) shows Christ and a man across surging waves, apparently the walking on the water (Matthew 14), not Mark 4; not used.
No Christ in the synagogue or Isaiah free (Isaiah appears only in duccio-nativity, used).

art.title: The Veil of Veronica
art.why: The face of Christ, crowned with thorns, on a hanging cloth: a 'portrait of Christ' for the session on who he was. No Christ among the Doctors is free.

art.title: Christ Blessing
art.why: Already this journey's own painting in content/journeys.json: keep it for the verdict.

music.why: The ancient Advent chant of Israel's hope for a Messiah: the world he was born into.
Kept from the live journey: a chorale about a person rather than an idea.
An old Irish prayer addressed to Christ as High King: a confession of who he is.
A hymn written after a shipwreck: faith in the one who stills storms.
Handel's Messiah is built from the very prophecies Christians read as fulfilled.
The Passion chorale: the teacher whose claims led him to the cross.
A hymn of worship: what the verdict means if he was right.
